# Function: minDynamicVector()

```ts
function minDynamicVector(value?, resolution?): Vector3;
```

Sampled component-wise minimum; unreadable values return a zero vector. Inputs are not mutated.

## Parameters

### value?

[`DynamicValue`](../type-aliases/DynamicValue.md)\<[`Vector3Input`](../type-aliases/Vector3Input.md)\> = `0`

### resolution?

`number` = `16`

## Returns

`Vector3`
